title: ChezCat HTML/XHTML standards and fixture inventory
kind: Source snapshot inventory; not detailed milestone acceptance or whole-browser conformance
interpretation: The preserved standards pins and inventory records support the existing offline fixture tools. Counts and named surfaces do not measure browser completion.
Status and verification text inside inventory records describe the identified source snapshot. They are not current detailed milestone acceptance records.
Relative document and source paths inside inventory records refer to the identified historical source snapshot, not to current live files.
The frozen cohort retains its own source revision, inventory digest and input identities in tools/reference/html-foundation/selection.json.

status_definitions.blocked: Specific required prerequisite absent, not a pass
status_definitions.verified: Exact source and required evidence close the contract
